articles.summary: Regency Centers announced the acquisition of a portfolio of five premier suburban shopping centers, all located within the 23,000-acre Rancho Mission Viejo (“RMV”) master-planned community in Orange County, CA.
articles.title: Regency Centers Completes $357M Portfolio Acquisition in Southern California

articles.summary: Regency's leasing momentum in Colorado has ramped up across two Denver-area centers in particular: Applewood Village and Buckley Square.
articles.title: Strategic Leasing Expands Regency’s Colorado Portfolio
